Subject: Renewal + EU air-gapped analytics cluster / capacity uplift

Hi Jasmine,

Our annual contract is up for renewal in August. We need to discuss two items before we sign: 1) adding an EU air-gapped analytics environment (for PHI processing) that is fully isolated from our US environment, and 2) increasing private cluster capacity for live inference by +3 GPU nodes to handle new clinical ingestion workloads.

High level requirements attached (vega_msp_requirements.pdf). Security will need SOC2 evidence and a network diagram showing the air-gap design. Procurement wants an updated quote that reflects a 24-month term and the additional capacity.

Can you confirm timelines and whether Redwood can support an EU on-premise air-gapped package with separate key management? We are aiming to have procurement sign-off by 6/25.

Thanks,
Samir Khan
Director, Platform Engineering
VegaHealth

Hi Samir — thanks for the detail and the attachment. We can absolutely support an EU-airgapped analytics site with customer-managed KMS and isolated VPC routing; I'll loop in Grace (Solutions) and Marissa (Account Exec) to scope the architecture and pricing.

Preliminary answers:
- EU air-gap: supported as a Private deployment (on-prem or partner-hosted). We provide a private control plane option and can integrate with your HSM/KMS for key custody.
- +3 GPU nodes: we can reserve dedicated capacity and recommend staging the extra nodes as a burst pool for the first 90 days to validate throughput.
- Term: 24-month commitment is fine; we typically offer a 6% discount on multi-year commits for Private plans, we can confirm exact numbers.

Can you confirm which EU country the air-gapped site will be in and whether your security team prefers an on-prem box or partner colocation? Also adding procurement contact (Aisha) would be helpful so Marissa can send a commercial outline.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call tomorrow (Thu 11th) to review the draft architecture and list of evidence they need for SOC2. Does 14:00 CET work?

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Marissa / Jasmine — quick internal notes before tomorrow's call with VegaHealth:

1) Architecture ask
- Recommend: Separate Private control plane (EU region), isolated inference cluster for analytics (no peering to US), dedicated KV-cache disable on analytics cluster, and customer-managed HSM for keys. We'll provide the eu-dataflow-diagram.png to illustrate.

2) Capacity sizing
- Current production baseline: 12 inference GPUs (reported by Samir in earlier emails). Proposal: +3 reserved GPUs (p3-equivalent) with autoscale headroom for bursts. Suggest a 90-day ramp with telemetry-driven autoscaling thresholds.

3) Commercial
- 24-month term with upfront 50% payment triggers and the remainder billed quarterly. For Private environments, line items: base infra fee, reserved GPU units (per GPU-month), private control plane license, and onboarding professional services (install + airgap validation).

4) Compliance pack
- We can provide SOC2 report, architecture diagram, and an audit playbook. Redaction note: we need PR approval to share some internal benchmark docs; Priyom to advise on redlines.

Action items (owners):
- Grace: draft technical architecture + costed bill of materials (by EOD Thu)
- Marissa: draft commercial outline and preliminary SOW (by Fri)
- Priyom: review contract template and identify any airgap-specific clause we need (e.g., data egress prohibition)

I'll prep eu-dataflow-diagram.png and a short slide for the call.

-Grace
